ranking.order: descending; ties by numeric Design ID

interpretation_limits: The submitted 27-residue pocket and the extracted 14-residue pocket use different structure digests and numbering frames; no residue-to-residue mapping or numerical subtraction is valid without the structure bytes and explicit alignment.
Saved arm20-40 and submitted binding20-60 are separate displayed fields; the addendum preserves both and does not resolve their disagreement.
CSV timestamps are retained verbatim; row created_at values are about4h after the saved job creation and later than original folding completion; no corrected timestamp or completion time is inferred.
CSV rank is export position, not Boltz2-Exact ipSAE rank.
Sequence-property values are provider estimates, may apply to generated native core before fixed-tail assembly, and are not experimental measurements; N-end-rule minutes are not serum half-life.
Generated sequences, predicted complex quality and attention views do not establish intended-pocket binding, agonism, or experimental affinity.
The provenance addendum applies to original LigandForge candidates and their lineage; AP Novo children retain their own generation method and frozen settings.
